data.name: Khaulaht
data.gender_notes: Khaulaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle like a flower, blooming in the garden of life. The name Khaulaht carries the meaning “Gentle Flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khaulaht usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and resilience, reminding us to be gentle and compassionate towards ourselves and others.
data.etymology: Khaulaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle Flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khaulaht total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_english.name: Khaulaht
in_english.long_meaning: Khaulaht is an Arabic-originated name that means 'beautiful girl' or 'lovely'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'kh-w-l', which relates to beauty and charm. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes aesthetic appeal and inner beauty. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to describe women of great beauty and character. The name Khaulaht is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a girl who embodies both physical and spiritual beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khaulaht in Islamic culture represents elegance, grace, and gentleness, drawing inspiration from the gentle nature of a blooming flower. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl, reflecting the softness and beauty inherent in Islam and Arabic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Khaulaht carries deeper meaning as a reminder of the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah (Swt). It signifies the importance of being a gentle and compassionate person, reflecting the softness and Mercy of Allah in one's actions and demeanor. It also signifies the individual's ongoing striving towards personal and spiritual growth, as a beautiful bloom in the garden of life.
